title: Unit Event — Start Rolling! Stars' Crossing — Episode3 Explosive Supernova

meta.Event Outline: The Lumina Grand Prix has come at last. The preliminary stage will take place in a specially-built glamorous accommodation facility! A nervous Minori throws herself into life on camera alongside a colorful array of rivals, but she soon meets hurdles.

rows.Line: The Lumina Forum - Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Wait, what's the Sparkly Shooting Star...?
Oh, that's right! The people of Earth don't know♪

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: The Sparkly Shooting Star is the biiig meteor I rode on to get to this planet☆

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hikarin's... Oh, now I remember!)

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: I'm Hikarin, the biggest idol in the galaxy☆ My smile has the power to brighten up the entire universe!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: All you reporters out there better get pictures of me now, because I might just end up this competition's dark-horse winner!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I saw her during orientation...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(If I recall, she works all by herself.
So, the fact that she's here is really amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
What you just said doesn't help us at all.
Is it safe to say that you're supposed to be a space alien?

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: No, it's not!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
I'm a fairy from Planet Twinkle!
I came here to spread twinkly hope to all of you☆

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Alright, so that's your gimmick.

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Nooo!
You're not listening!

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: There you go again, Arisa...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Those two are really lighting it up...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just look at the comments.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<LOL!>
<I'll remember you, Hikarin!>
<Nice one, Arisa!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
I can't read what they're saying because they're zooming by so fast!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Arisa's so quick-witted.
By being a bit sharp, she was able to highlight Hikarin's character setting.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, and...

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: I have ironclad proof that I'm from Planet Twinkle! Here, take a look at this!

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
Huh? A certificate of residence?!
Wait, what does this even say...?

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: It's not written in Japanese... I've never seen letters or symbols like these before.

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Well, duh!
That's how you write in Twinklese!

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Y-You even came up with your own language...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hikarin also deserves a lot of credit.
She's doing a great job of keeping the conversation going with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That's right...! In order to get noticed, you have to know how to keep conversations like this going!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Which means I need to consciously make an effort there...!)

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: No, why won't any of you believe me?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: D-Don't worry, Hikarin! I believe you!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Whaaaat?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes, really! I believe in ghosts and monsters!
I even got struck with sleep paralysis just the other day!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Wait, what?!
Don't talk about me like I'm some sort of monster!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Uh oh. Minori just dissed Hikarin without realizing it, and scored a clean hit!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?! N-No, I didn't mean to...!
Uhh... Uhh...!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Minori's bullying Hikarin lol.>
<Isn't she from MMJ?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Also, did you really suffer from sleep paralysis? I'm actually really afraid of ghosts and monsters...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, yes...! That really happened!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: While I was sleeping, I felt this enormous weight come over my body. It was so heavy that I couldn't move at all...!

rows.Speaker: Other Idols
rows.Line: Wait, that's actually really scary...

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: Were you okay afterwards?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Wh-What do I do?!
This conversation was going in a fun direction, but I made things awkward...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I have to turn this around somehow!
Uhh... But what do I say...?!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Doesn't that mean Samo decided to sleep on you...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, Samo's about the right weight in terms of making you feel that way...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, come to think of it, there was fur all over my covers!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Detective Haruka's on the case.>
<Samo?>
<What's a Samo?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Samo's the dog at Minori's house.
He's a Samoyed, which is a really big breed.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: He does tend to start feeling lonely whenever she's away for an extended period. That may be why he decided to sleep on top of you.

rows.Speaker: Other Idols
rows.Line: Th-Thank goodness it wasn't a ghost!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I also feel a lot better!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(Haruka and the others really saved me there...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Trying to get noticed while keeping things fun in this sea of idols is...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Just so hard...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I can't afford to give up...!)

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Anyway, let's refocus our attention on getting to know what the rehearsal room has to offer! My trainer friend here will explain!

rows.Speaker: Trainer
rows.Line: Alright, let's start at the front.

rows.Speaker: Trainer
rows.Line:
That's about everything.
Would you all like to take these machines for a spin now?

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Wait, right now?

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: In that case, Chiharu, why don't we try the machines that interest you the most?

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Thanks...! I'll appreciate your support!
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, as for us...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I have a suggestion...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's try out the machine over there that analyzes the way you dance!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That one... If I recall, after you perform the dance for a song in front of its camera, it'll tell you how to improve.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Kinda like the scoring system they have at karaoke places. That could be fun.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Then, let's all try it together!
Let's see... I thought I just saw on the menu screen... I knew it! It has “Level 10-Billion Heart♡”, the song we danced for that stream the other day!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, people requested that song because everyone's been talking about it. The four of us should have no problem doing that dance.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh, MMJ's gonna dance Level 10-Billion Heart♡!>
<That song's so cute.>
<I can't wait to see MMJ's rendition of it.>

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Oh, that's a clever way to attract the cameras. People always love it when you perform the dance to a song that they know...

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: But we can't let them hog all the glory!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, everyone, are you watching...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (They all want to be entertained, so I have to succeed this time!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'll turn on the camera... Okay, it's ready.
I'm playing the song now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<They're so cute!>
<They're amazing dancers.>
<That's them for you.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(So far so good!
I just need to keep this up and not make any mistakes...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Wait, huh...?
Which leg am I supposed to stick out next?!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Uhh... Uhh...!
What do I do?! I'm drawing a total blank...!)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Huh? One of them isn't doing it right.>
<She's acting kinda funny lol.>
<She looks like a robot.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(This is bad...!
I have to fix this somehow...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Alright, here goes nothing...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(...!
She improvised her way back!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Nice work! Now we just have to...)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Was that improvised?!>
<That came out of left field lol.>
<Is it smart to improvise when you're being scored?>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Didn't she just make a mistake?>
<That was really cute.>
<How's this gonna affect their score? Lol.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Uhh... Wh-What do I do...?!)

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Hnng! Hnnng!!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Twinkle, twinkle, sparkly meteorite! Wh-Wh-Wh-Whoosh☆

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! Hikarin?!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Minorin, what you just did...!
I think you were trying to do the Hikarin dance!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? The Hikarin dance...?

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It's the dance I came up with for sending messages to other star systems!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: You wave your hands like they're shooting stars streaking across the sky. Twinkle☆ Twinkle☆

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
U-Uhh...
Twinkle?

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
That's it!
You're doing really well, Minorin☆

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Lol, what's happening now?>
<She's so unique!>
<I like how confused she is.>

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Finally, you spread your arms and legs out like you're creating the big bang! Start by pulling them in really tight, and... Explode!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: E-Explode?! Like this?!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
You're so good at doing the Hikarin dance, Minorin!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sh-She sorta just got sucked into her vortex...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<MMJ's just watching in amazement lol.>
<They make a fun pair.>
<I wanna see MMJ and Hikarin do the Level 10-Billion Heart dance.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Everything ended up going alright.

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
That was the Minorin-Hikarin dance!
Thanks for watching!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Now, I need to go work on my shooting-star step! Bye bye☆

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...! There she goes...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She really just came and went.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Still, hehe...
She seemed like such a nice space fairy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I think I like Hikarin.>
<I wanna know what she's gonna do next now.>
<I hope she shows up again soon.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She was only here for a second, but Hikarin managed to connect with everyone watching...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(...
I need to keep trying to do better...!)
